ImageDescription.value:
The Battle Hymn of the Republic is a popular American song with lyrics by Julia Ward Howe to a traditional tune collected and popularized by William Steffe in 1856. Another popular version of the same music is "John Brown's Body".

This was performed by Miss Stevenson, Mr. Stanley and Mixed Quartette in 1908 for Edison Records. It is Edison Amberol #79.
